description: This file contains backend API implementations for the COSA Data Model Library, including functions for creating, initializing, and removing host data structures, as well as memory management utilities.

methods.name: CosaHostsCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new COSA hosts object, returning its handle.

methods.name: CosaHostsInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the COSA hosts object, setting up internal data structures.

methods.name: CosaHostsRemove
methods.description: Removes and frees resources associated with the COSA hosts object.

methods.name: LanManager_CloneString
methods.description: Clones a string by allocating new memory and copying the content.
